title: release-cindy-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified Cindy plugin release with an installable .cindy asset.

requirements.summary: Release only the Cindy adapter, attach the matching installer, and retain one local rollback package.
acceptanceCriteria: Only Cindy package and ghost manifest fourth segments are bumped.
The target .cindy embedded manifest is valid and matches vcindy-<version>.
Local build outputs contain the target plus at most one latest older rollback package.
The GitHub Release contains the matching immutable .cindy asset and no npm package is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Cindy release baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, Cindy manifests, existing .cindy outputs, and every worktree change. Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Prepare and verify the Cindy source
tasks.detail: Bump only Cindy package.json and plugin/ghost.json fourth segments, validate manifest constraints and skill consistency, synchronize required content, run focused checks, and review the complete diff.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source release gate
tasks.detail: Commit intended content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run npm run verify:release, then create and push vcindy-<version>.

tasks.title: Build, retain, and publish the Cindy installer
tasks.detail: Build the target .cindy from tagged source and verify its embedded ghost.json. Only after success, delete expired matching outputs while retaining the target and one numerically latest older rollback package. Create the GitHub Release and attach the target installer asset.

tasks.title: Verify the Cindy release and optional install
tasks.detail: Verify tag, immutable asset URL, filename, size, embedded version, and repository cleanliness. Only when separately requested, install via Cindy confirmation, check logs, restart, and verify enabled/running target version.

references.why: Owns manifest, package, retention, publication, and installation rules.

rules: Never publish npm packages or modify another adapter.
Never prune the rollback package before the target installer is verified.
Never publish a Cindy release without its matching .cindy asset.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
